name: Restaurant De Kas
lunchNote: Lunch menu, 3 courses · Mon–Sat (4 courses €67, 5 courses €76)
chef: Wim de Beer and Jos Timmer

menus.name: dinner menu
menus.note: Changes weekly with the garden's vegetables, with some fish or meat; can be served fully vegetarian or vegan.

bookingOpens: Online through the reservation system on the restaurant's website (Zenchef), up to 3 months ahead. Lunch arrivals Monday to Saturday, 12pm to 1.45pm; dinner 6pm to 9pm.
cancellation: Bookings for up to 6 people can be cancelled free of charge. Groups of 7 or more pay a €50 deposit per person, deducted from the bill; it is kept as a no-show fee if the booking is cancelled on the day (after 10am for lunch or after 3pm for dinner).
waitlist: If a table comes free, the restaurant calls guests on the waiting list.
groups: Tables of up to 12 can book online. Groups of 13 to 20 use the glass-walled Garden Room; the whole restaurant can be hired for 80 to 140 guests. Groups in between can't be taken.
children: Children are welcome, with a special children's menu; mention a pushchair when booking.
duration: Lunch tables are kept until 4pm; dinner until midnight, or 8.30pm for an early dinner booking.
